scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n web,app -c cyan,green "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm --filter kamehouse-desktop dev"
scripts.build:server: go -C apps/server build -o kamehouse.exe . && pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$b='apps/desktop/src-tauri/binaries'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $b | Out-Null; @('windows.exe','darwin-amd64','darwin-arm64','linux-amd64','linux-arm64') | ForEach-Object { Copy-Item 'apps/server/kamehouse.exe' \"$b/kamehouse-server-$_-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe\" -Force; Copy-Item 'apps/server/kamehouse.exe' \"$b/kamehouse-server-$_.exe\" -Force; Copy-Item 'apps/server/kamehouse.exe' \"$b/kamehouse-server-$_\" -Force }"
scripts.clean: pnpm --recursive exec rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf node_modules
